findings.detail: web-search-llm-filtering retrieves and filters evidence but does not perform the required domain-agent keyword enhancement.
agricultural-query-decomposition-into-subqueries emits retrieval inputs and does not retrieve local or web evidence.
per-query-composite-score-analysis analyzes precomputed composite scores and does not score cited answers from the supplied human annotations.
llm-multi-agent-orchestration produces governed household-energy JSON and does not synthesize the AgriIR A-D-W answer bundle.
llm-response-quality-annotation-aggregation evaluates completed responses and does not synthesize an answer from retrieved evidence.
